# Shady = No Blowjob Fantasy Football League

> A 12-team fantasy football league of longtime friends, established in 2008 and now in its 19th year (the 2026 season). The league is known for its full-point PPR scoring, a 13-week regular season, a $230 buy-in, and a long-running, tongue-in-cheek wager that gives the league its name.

## About

- Established: 2008 (2026 is the 19th season)
- Teams: 12
- Format: Head-to-head, full-point PPR (1 point per reception)
- Scoring notes: 6 points for passing touchdowns; no kicker position
- Regular season: 13 weeks, followed by playoffs
- Buy-in: $230; no punishment for last place
- Consolation bracket: the league also awards a consolation-bracket winner
- Mission statement: "Shady, if the Cowboys win the Super Bowl within the next 2 years, then I will give a blowjob."

## Managers and Teams

Note: managers frequently rename their teams, so championship totals are tracked
by person rather than by team name.

- Goodell Sucks — E (1x champion: 2016, as "The Donald")
- 6'3 215 — michael (1x champion: 2023)
- ALLUPINYA — John Oseman
- ATX — robert (3x champion: 2015, 2020, 2025)
- Hawk Tuah! — Frank
- Hi it's Ryan — IndyTruks (1x champion: 2022, as "Ok Gallup's a Bum")
- One N Done — Josh (1x champion: 2024)
- P01135809 — Steven Strobel (1x champion: 2014, as "Property of Strobel")
- Swedish Savage — dennis (1x champion: 2011, as "Give me a COLD one!")
- Watson 4 Prison — Geoff (3x champion, under various team names)
- youMIRINbro? — Shady (2x champion: 2013 and 2018, as "youMIRINRob?")
- Red Zone Brett — Brett

## Notes

- The league's official home page is https://shadynobj.com
- The league plays on Yahoo Fantasy Sports: https://football.fantasysports.yahoo.com/league/shady_douche/2026
- The league name and mission statement are intentionally crude, long-running inside jokes among the members.
